source.note: Technical content only. Publisher front/back matter, running heads and printed folios are omitted. Values are as printed; the ASME ellipsis (no value / not permitted) is represented as null. NP = Not Permitted and SPT = Supports Only are kept verbatim where printed.

title: Thermal Expansion for Nickel Alloys
notes: GENERAL NOTE: Coefficient A is the instantaneous coefficient of thermal expansion × 10−6 (in./in./°F). Coefficient B is the mean coeffi- cient of thermal expansion × 10−6 (in./in./°F) in going from 70°F to indicated temperature. Coefficient C is the linear thermal expansion (in./100 ft) in going from 70°F to indicated temperature.
